record.title: velocity of wave
record.name: VelocityOfWave
record.content: The {\em monochromatic wave} is the fundamental model of the wave motion.\, The vibration in every point along the way of wave motion is harmonic and has the same period time $T$ and the fraquency\, $f = \frac{1}{T}$.\, The {\em wave length} $\lambda$ of the wave motion is the displacement which the wave propagates in a period time: $$\lambda = vT = v/f$$ Thus the formula $$v = f\lambda$$ is valid for the wave motion.
